statement:
{V} [AddCommGroup V] [LinearAlgebraGame.VectorSpace ℂ V] [LinearAlgebraGame.InnerProductSpace_v V] (u v : V)
  (h : LinearAlgebraGame.orthogonal u v) : ‖u + v‖ ^ 2 = ‖u‖ ^ 2 + ‖v‖ ^ 2
name: LinearAlgebraGame.pythagorean
content:
This is the Pythagorean Theorem. If you have vectors `u v`, and `h : orthogonal u v`, then
`pythagorean u v h` is a proof that `‖u + v‖^2 = ‖u‖^2 + ‖v‖^2`.
